title: Power torsion for arbitrary local Hom on an affine open
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], f a global function with derived scalar action [def-sc-derived-global-scalar], and E,E\prime objects of D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose E is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] and every cohomology stalk of E\prime outside V(f) is zero. For an affine open U, write R_U for derived localized-site restriction [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris]. For every integer k and every morphism beta:R_U E -> R_U(E\prime[k]), there is n>=0 with R_U(f^n id_E) composed with beta equal to zero. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness of X is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08EJ, affine paragraph, applied on an affine open

proof.text: For k obtain the affine module models P,M,F,eP,eM, finite-projective bounds, cohomological torsion and scalar compatibility from [lem-sc-perfect-support-affine-module-model]. Fullness lifts eP.hom composed with beta and eM.inv to alpha:Q(P) to M.
Apply [lem-sc-bounded-projective-hom-power-torsion] with the restricted scalar f|U to alpha, obtaining n with (f|U)^n alpha=0.

Rewrite scalar multiplication of alpha as precomposition with the scalar identity, apply the additive functor F, and use map_preimage. The power of a compatible scalar family evaluates to the power of its component at U. Apply the model scalar comparison at f^n, reassociate, and cancel the isomorphisms eP.hom and eM.inv. This gives precisely R(schemeDerivedScalar X (f^n) id_E) composed with beta=0.

proof_origin.note: Stage-3 decomposition of the Stacks 08EJ affine proof; explicit model comparison and ring Hom induction are independent remaining tasks.

theorem perfect_support_affine_open_torsion
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (f : RingCat.sectionsSubring (X.sheaf.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u}))
    (E E' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (hE : X.IsPerfect E.obj)
    (hSupport : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ X.zeroLocus (U := ⊤) {f.val (op ⊤)} →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E'.obj).val.presheaf x)))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ (k : ℤ) (β : R.obj E.obj ⟶ R.obj (E'.obj⟦k⟧)),
      ∃ n : ℕ, R.map (schemeDerivedScalar X (f ^ n) (𝟙 E.obj)) ≫ β = 0
